open_points.subject: enter_viewer_access
open_points.text:
IMPORTED DATA ACCESS SIGNATURES (constants from the imports above — read them, never redefine them; their values are not part of this context):
CREDENTIAL_SECRET_BYTES: int
VIEWER_SESSION_TTL_DAYS: int
open_points.other_text: - enter_viewer_access: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST set the session expires_at to created_at plus the viewer session lifetime, the imported VIEWER_SESSION_TTL_DAYS constant in days, and MUST NOT invent a lifetime or leave expires_at equal to created_at; an expiry that is not strictly later than created_at rejects the client on the next request. created_at and expires_at MUST both come from the one timestamp captured for this entry, so the lifetime is exactly the configured span.
open_points.question: Must VIEWER_SESSION_TTL_DAYS be guaranteed to be a positive integer, or must the requirement permit zero or negative imported values even though zero leaves expires_at equal to created_at and non-positive values do not produce a strictly later expiry?
